title: Kettle On (stock happy home interior, SNES register)
_note: Stock HAPPY-A home interior (first use: Galehigh's Terrace Cottage). 90 BPM 4/4, F major, 24 bars: A (8) -> A' (8, climbs to D5, cadences home) -> B (8, Bb/Gm/Dm, the warm middle, ends on C to lead back). Lead is a soft reed (pulse50, clarinet-ish) opening on a bounced Vesper contour C-F-G then A-G-F settle. Pluck = harp/pizzicato eighth arps, celesta (bell) answers at phrase ends, oom-pah triangle bass bounce, brushed hat backbeat only. Five voices: a small, warm room.
